> 📘 Note
> 
> New Sandbox API endpoint: <https://api.us.webexconnect.io/v1/sms/messages/{messageId}>

## API reference metadata

These are source metadata and examples. `api.auth` is ReadMe metadata; verify authentication in the documented headers/security scheme.

```json
{
  "method": "get",
  "url": "",
  "auth": "required",
  "params": [],
  "results": {
    "codes": []
  },
  "apiSetting": "6a675233ec1c893d8a7f67c6"
}
```

## OpenAPI operation and component schemas

```json
{
  "openapi": "3.0.0",
  "info": {
    "version": "1",
    "title": "SMS API",
    "description": ""
  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://api-sandbox.imiconnect.io"
    }
  ],
  "security": null,
  "path": "/v1/sms/messages/{messageId}",
  "method": "get",
  "path_parameters": [],
  "operation": {
    "tags": [
      "Status"
    ],
    "summary": "Retrieve the status of an SMS message",
    "security": [
      {
        "BearerToken": []
      }
    ],
    "parameters": [
      {
        "name": "messageId",
        "schema": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "in": "path",
        "required": true,
        "description": "The message ID being queried"
      }
    ],
    "responses": {
      "200": {
        "headers": {
          "Request-Id": {
            "$ref": "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          }
        },
        "description": "Message status",
        "content": {
          "application/json": {
            "schema": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/MessageStatusResponse"
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "404": {
        "headers": {
          "Request-Id": {
            "$ref": "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          }
        },
        "description": "Invalid message ID"
      },
      "500": {
        "headers": {
          "Request-Id": {
            "$ref": "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          }
        },
        "description": "Internal error processing the request",
        "content": {
          "application/json": {
            "schema": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "components": {
    "parameters": {
      "IdempotencyKey": {
        "name": "Idempotency-Key",
        "in": "header",
        "required": true,
        "schema": {
          "type": "string",
          "maxLength": 64,
          "pattern": "^[\\w=\\-]+$"
        },
        "example": "5a38810a-acc0-4f5e-851f-95c02e03930c",
        "description": "An optional user provided value that is used to prevent duplicate requests.  API requests with an Idempotency-Key value that has been used in the previous 1 hours will be rejected as a duplicate request."
      }
    },
    "headers": {
      "RequestId": {
        "schema": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "example": "ca44810a-acc0-4f5e-851f-95c02e03110a",
        "description": "Unique ID that identifies this HTTP request."
      }
    },
    "securitySchemes": {
      "BearerToken": {
        "type": "http",
        "scheme": "bearer",
        "description": "Authorization token (this can be either a JWT signed by a secret key or a service key)"
      }
    },
    "schemas": {
      "ErrorResponse": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "code",
          "message"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "code": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "message": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Human readable description of error state"
          }
        }
      },
      "CallbackMessageEvent": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "messageId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Message's unique ID",
            "example": "96fe8948-bc7c-4eae-8118-78f0ad64f27c"
          },
          "statusTime": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Timestamp in ISO8601 format reflecting when the message status was updated",
            "example": "2021-07-29T13:45:33.404Z"
          },
          "status": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "QUEUED",
              "SENT",
              "DELIVERED",
              "FAILED"
            ],
            "description": "Message status"
          },
          "callbackData": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CallbackData"
          },
          "correlationId": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CorrelationId"
          },
          "error": {
            "description": "This is only included if the status is FAILED",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "MessageStatusResponse": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "messageId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Message's unique ID",
            "example": "96fe8948-bc7c-4eae-8118-78f0ad64f27c"
          },
          "acceptedTime": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AcceptedTime"
          },
          "from": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Short or long code that the message was sent from",
            "example": 34343
          },
          "to": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "E.164",
            "description": "Mobile device phone number in E.164 format that the message was sent to",
            "example": "+19545551212"
          },
          "correlationId": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CorrelationId"
          },
          "content": {
            "type": "string",
            "example": "Hello, world!",
            "description": "Actual message content that was sent to the device.  This contains any substitutions that may have been made."
          },
          "contentType": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ContentType"
          },
          "dltTemplateId": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DltTemplateId"
          },
          "status": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "QUEUED",
              "SENT",
              "DELIVERED",
              "FAILED"
            ],
            "description": "Message status"
          },
          "statusTime": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Timestamp in ISO8601 format reflecting when the message status was updated",
            "example": "2021-07-29T13:45:33.404Z"
          },
          "error": {
            "description": "This is only included if the status is FAILED",
            "allOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "SendSmsRequest": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "from",
          "to",
          "content"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "from": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Short or long code that the message should be sent from",
            "example": 34343
          },
          "to": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "The mobile device phone number in E.164 format that should receive the message",
            "format": "E.164",
            "example": "+19545551212"
          },
          "content": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Text message content or template ID to be used to send to the mobile device",
            "example": "Hello world!",
            "maxLength": 1024
          },
          "contentType": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ContentType"
          },
          "substitutions": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "Members of this object are used to replace placeholders within the content or template specified.",
            "properties": {
              "key1": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "key2": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "key3": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            }
          },
          "correlationId": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CorrelationId"
          },
          "dltTemplateId": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DltTemplateId"
          },
          "callbackUrl": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "URI",
            "example": "https://my.website.com/callback",
            "description": "If provided, events related to the delivery of this message will be POSTed to this URL."
          },
          "callbackData": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CallbackData"
          },
          "expireAt": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "ISO8601",
            "description": "If the message has not been sent by this date & time, it will be removed from the sending queue",
            "example": "2021-08-01T14:24:33.000Z"
          }
        }
      },
      "ContentType": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "TEXT",
          "TEMPLATE",
          "UNICODE",
          "FLASH",
          "BINARY"
        ],
        "default": "TEXT",
        "description": "Denotes whether the content string is the actual text content to be sent or a reference to a template ID."
      },
      "DltTemplateId": {
        "type": "string",
        "example": "2kRCRhhxOmT28jMn",
        "description": "Specifies the DLT template ID used for this message.  This is only used in certain regions."
      },
      "SendSmsResponse": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "acceptedTime": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AcceptedTime"
          },
          "messageId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Unique ID identifying this message",
            "example": "0e36bb32-5f5d-46c9-b132-85e010a80c2a"
          },
          "correlationId": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CorrelationId"
          }
        }
      },
      "CorrelationId": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "User defined ID that is assigned to an individual message",
        "example": "de36bb32-3f5d-46c9-b132-15e010a80ccc"
      },
      "CallbackData": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Additional data that will be echoed back in all callback requests made to callbackUrl",
        "example": "customerID123|1234|new_sale"
      },
      "AcceptedTime": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Timestamp in ISO8601 format when message was received by the API",
        "example": "2021-07-29T13:45:33.404Z"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
